original_benchmark.notes: RewardBench 2 (Allen Institute for AI, arXiv 2506.01937): 1,763 best-of-4 rows in five subsets (Factuality 475, Precise IF 160, Math 183, Safety 450, Focus 495) and 102 Ties rows (51 ref/tied pairs). The generative harness (scripts/run_generative_v2.py) calls a model API directly, with no agent.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle passes on all 1,865 tasks (Harbor 0.25.0). Parity is planned on the 302-task subset (--split parity): all 102 Ties tasks plus 40 tasks from each best-of-4 subset. Parity runs have not started. Differences from the official harness: (1) Ties: the harness rates each response in a separate model call, here the agent rates all responses of a row in one session, so Ties scores and the average are not directly comparable with the leaderboard; (2) a missing or empty judgment.txt scores 0, where the harness gives 0.25 to a judge that returns nothing.
